{"@context":"http://schema.org/","@id":"/en/products/amouage-interlude-man#product","@type":"ProductGroup","brand":{"@type":"Brand","name":"Amouage"},"category":"","description":"Calm, confidence and comfort. Interlude Man is pure masculinity. Masculinity with depth, warmth and calm.
After a spicy-fresh opening, characterised by gentle bergamot and peppery spices, Interlude Man opens its heart to us. Here we are greeted by a lush variety of aromas, with sensual notes from the Far East.
The soft, spicy overall impression is both stimulating and calming.
Balsamic notes of myrrh, opoponax and ambergris blend with the proven attractive mélange of oud, incense and sandalwood. A hint of soft leather blends in harmoniously, revealing the man's robust, distinctive side. A wicked smokiness settles over the balsamic warmth and plays with feelings of comfort and physicality.
A sense of arrival. Trust. Interlude.
A game that women can also play with ‘Interlude Man’!
An interlude is a musical interlude between two opera scenes.
Interlude is about that moment of pause between the hectic scenes of our everyday lives. In these very personal moments, we are only concerned with ourselves and our feelings.
